en.name: Body weight
en.shortDescription: Body weight — the patient's current weight, measured or with no method stated, in any context (incl. around dialysis or surgery); in kilograms (kg).
en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

Body weight is the patient's current weight, read off a scale, bed scale or hoist scale, or recorded with no method stated. It produces a single numeric value per patient-timestamp, recorded on admission and repeatedly during the stay, and underpins drug dosing, fluid balance, nutrition and ventilator settings. It is reported in kilograms (kg).

## Included Concepts

The set is anchored on the SNOMED *Body weight* concept with its descendants, plus SNOMED *Post-amputation measured body weight* (not a descendant) and the LOINC body-weight concepts (LOINC carries no hierarchy, so they are listed flat). They are grouped below for readability only — all belong to the same `body_weight` variable, all in kg.

### Generic body weight (default)

- *4099154 / 27113001 — Body weight (SNOMED)* and *3025315 / 29463-7 — Body weight (LOINC)*: the default, context not specified.
- *42536495 / 735395000 — Current body weight (SNOMED)*: the patient's weight now.

### Measured

- *4178502 / 363808001 — Body weight measure (SNOMED)* and *3013762 / 3141-9 — Body weight Measured (LOINC)*: a weight explicitly measured.
- *37160438 / 1162415002 — Post-amputation measured body weight (SNOMED)*: the current measured weight of a patient after an amputation.

### Around dialysis

- *37160447 / 1162421003 — Pre-dialysis body weight (SNOMED)* and *3019336 / 8347-7 — Body weight Measured --pre dialysis (LOINC)*: measured before a dialysis session.
- *37160443 / 1162420002 — Post-dialysis body weight (SNOMED)* and *3009617 / 8344-4 — Body weight Measured --post dialysis (LOINC)*: measured after a dialysis session.

### Other contexts

- *3005422 / 8349-3 — Body weight Measured --preoperative (LOINC)* and *3015644 / 8346-9 — Body weight Measured --postoperative (LOINC)*: measured before or after surgery.
- *3013853 / 8338-6 — Body weight Measured --ante partum (LOINC)* and *3010147 / 8345-1 — Body weight Measured --post partum (LOINC)*: measured during pregnancy or after delivery.
- *40761330 / 58229-6 — Body weight Measured --when specimen taken (LOINC)*: measured when a specimen was collected.
- *3010220 / 8350-1 — Body weight Measured --with clothes (LOINC)*, *3011054 / 8351-9 — Body weight Measured --without clothes (LOINC)*, *4310154 / 424927000 — Body weight with shoes (SNOMED)* and *4175354 / 425024002 — Body weight without shoes (SNOMED)*: measured with or without clothes or shoes.

**Note on units**: reported in **kilograms** (`9529 / kg — kilogram`, UCUM), the recommended unit, as listed by LOINC for 29463-7, with a registered conversion from grams. For sources reporting pounds, the conversion table uses `[lb_us]` (OMOP concept 8739, factor 0.45359237). LOINC names the avoirdupois pound `[lb_av]`, the code defined by the UCUM specification, but the OMOP vocabulary has no concept for it; the only OMOP pound concepts left are `[lb_ap]` and `[lb_tr]` (apothecary and troy pound), which are about 0.82x the avoirdupois pound and would therefore be wrong by ~18%. `[lb_us]` is a standard concept of the UCUM vocabulary in OMOP carrying the correct mass (0.45359237 kg exactly, the international avoirdupois pound), so it is used here as the source unit. This gap is a known OHDSI issue (https://forums.ohdsi.org/t/ucum-concept-for-avoirdupois-pound/2808).

## Mapping Notes

- **Default concept** when the source records a weight without qualification: *4099154 / 27113001 — Body weight* (SNOMED) or *3025315 / 29463-7 — Body weight* (LOINC).
- **Method and context are attributes, not separate variables**: map to a specific concept (measured, pre-dialysis, preoperative…) only when the source documents it; otherwise use the generic concept.
- **Excluded from the set** (do not map here): self-reported weight, estimated weight (incl. Broselow paediatric estimation), past weights (baseline weight, previous well-weight, pre-amputation estimated/measured weight), dosing weight (the weight used to compute drug doses, which may be an ideal or adjusted weight) and dry body weight (a target weight without fluid overload) — none of them is the patient's current measured weight. Birth weight is also excluded because it has its own dedicated *Birth weight* set. Ideal body weight is a separate set (*Ideal body weight*).
- This set is built symmetrically with the *Body height* set (same anchoring strategy) so height and weight map consistently.

fr.name: Poids corporel
fr.shortDescription: Poids corporel — le poids actuel du patient, mesuré ou sans méthode précisée, dans tout contexte (y compris autour d’une dialyse ou d’une intervention) ; en kilogrammes (kg).
fr.longDescription:
## Définition et contexte clinique

Le poids corporel est le poids actuel du patient, lu sur une balance, un lit-balance ou un lève-malade pesant, ou enregistré sans méthode précisée. Il produit une valeur numérique unique par patient-horodatage, relevée à l'admission et de façon répétée durant le séjour, et sous-tend les posologies, le bilan hydrique, la nutrition et les réglages ventilatoires. Il est exprimé en kilogrammes (kg).

## Concepts inclus

Le jeu est ancré sur le concept SNOMED *Body weight* et ses descendants, plus le SNOMED *Post-amputation measured body weight* (qui n'en est pas un descendant) et les concepts LOINC de poids (LOINC n'a pas de hiérarchie, ils sont donc listés à plat). Ils sont regroupés ci-dessous à titre de lisibilité uniquement — tous relèvent de la même variable `body_weight`, tous en kg.

### Poids générique (par défaut)

- *4099154 / 27113001 — Body weight (SNOMED)* et *3025315 / 29463-7 — Body weight (LOINC)* : par défaut, contexte non précisé.
- *42536495 / 735395000 — Current body weight (SNOMED)* : le poids actuel du patient.

### Mesuré

- *4178502 / 363808001 — Body weight measure (SNOMED)* et *3013762 / 3141-9 — Body weight Measured (LOINC)* : un poids explicitement mesuré.
- *37160438 / 1162415002 — Post-amputation measured body weight (SNOMED)* : le poids actuel mesuré d'un patient après une amputation.

### Autour d'une dialyse

- *37160447 / 1162421003 — Pre-dialysis body weight (SNOMED)* et *3019336 / 8347-7 — Body weight Measured --pre dialysis (LOINC)* : mesuré avant une séance de dialyse.
- *37160443 / 1162420002 — Post-dialysis body weight (SNOMED)* et *3009617 / 8344-4 — Body weight Measured --post dialysis (LOINC)* : mesuré après une séance de dialyse.

### Autres contextes

- *3005422 / 8349-3 — Body weight Measured --preoperative (LOINC)* et *3015644 / 8346-9 — Body weight Measured --postoperative (LOINC)* : mesuré avant ou après une intervention.
- *3013853 / 8338-6 — Body weight Measured --ante partum (LOINC)* et *3010147 / 8345-1 — Body weight Measured --post partum (LOINC)* : mesuré pendant la grossesse ou après l'accouchement.
- *40761330 / 58229-6 — Body weight Measured --when specimen taken (LOINC)* : mesuré au moment d'un prélèvement.
- *3010220 / 8350-1 — Body weight Measured --with clothes (LOINC)*, *3011054 / 8351-9 — Body weight Measured --without clothes (LOINC)*, *4310154 / 424927000 — Body weight with shoes (SNOMED)* et *4175354 / 425024002 — Body weight without shoes (SNOMED)* : mesuré avec ou sans vêtements ou chaussures.

**Note sur les unités** : exprimé en **kilogrammes** (`9529 / kg — kilogram`, UCUM), l'unité recommandée, avec des conversions enregistrées depuis les grammes et les livres.

## Notes de mapping

- **Concept par défaut** quand la source enregistre un poids sans précision : *4099154 / 27113001 — Body weight* (SNOMED) ou *3025315 / 29463-7 — Body weight* (LOINC).
- **La méthode et le contexte sont des attributs, pas des variables distinctes** : ne mapper vers un concept spécifique (mesuré, pré-dialyse, préopératoire…) que si la source le documente ; sinon utiliser le concept générique.
- **Exclus du jeu** (ne pas mapper ici) : poids auto-déclaré, poids estimé (y compris estimation pédiatrique de Broselow), poids antérieurs (poids de référence, poids antérieur en bonne santé, poids pré-amputation estimé/mesuré), poids de posologie (le poids servant à calculer les doses, qui peut être un poids idéal ou ajusté) et poids sec (un poids cible, sans surcharge hydrique) — aucun n'est le poids actuel mesuré du patient. Le poids de naissance est aussi exclu car il dispose de son propre jeu *Birth weight*. Le poids idéal constitue un jeu distinct (*Ideal body weight*).
- Ce jeu est construit symétriquement au jeu *Body height* (même stratégie d'ancrage), pour un mapping cohérent taille/poids.

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Needs revision** Why use multiple codes that all mostly mean the same? And then some other codes where I'm not sure they are needed anywhere?

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI03 (Feeding).
- CQL: 1 of 7 concepts are referenced in [`IndicateQiElements.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQiElements.cql?plain=1): [4099154](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQiElements.cql?plain=1#L34) (each ID links to its code definition).
- Not used by our indicators (6): 3025315 Body weight, 4178502 Body weight measure, 37160443 Post-dialysis body weight, 37160447 Pre-dialysis body weight, 40484200 Dry body weight, 42536495 Current body weight.

## Suggestions
- Remove all but the SNOMED or LOINC code for Body weight

reviews.comments:
**Reply to the review of Gregor Lichtner**

Needs discussion:
- **Keep several concepts?** The aim of a concept set is to be broad enough that, whatever concept a site mapped its data to locally, the set captures it, provided the concept has the same clinical definition and the same dimension. Here the definition is the patient's current body weight, measured or with no method stated. Body weight has standard concepts in both SNOMED and LOINC, all in the Measurement domain and with the same dimension, at several levels of detail (generic, measured, around dialysis, before or after surgery, with or without clothes). They all record the same variable, and for a site any of them is correct.
- **The set does not presuppose how it will be used.** For the admission weight, a study takes the set and keeps the values recorded in the first 24 hours after ICU admission, whatever concept they were recorded with. To follow the weight over the stay, every concept gives a value of the patient's current weight at a point in time: a postoperative or post-dialysis weight is one more point on that curve, and removing it would only leave gaps.
- v1.2.0 therefore keeps them and adds the missing ones: LOINC *Body weight Measured* and its contexts (pre/post dialysis, pre/postoperative, ante/post partum, when specimen taken, with/without clothes), and SNOMED *Post-amputation measured body weight*.
- On the codes you were not sure about: estimated, self-reported and past weights (baseline, previous well-weight, pre-amputation), dosing weight and dry weight are excluded, as none of them is the patient's current measured weight.

What do you think?

versions.message: Resolves issue #2: anchored on SNOMED Body weight with descendants, plus generic LOINC; excluded self-reported/estimated/dosing/baseline/previous-well/pre-amputation weights; birth weight and dialysis/dry weights kept. Added clinical description and mapping notes. Birth weight is excluded because it has its own Birth weight set. Moved to pending review.

versions.message: Document the unit conversion in the description: pounds are converted with [lb_us] (8739), since OMOP has no concept for the UCUM code [lb_av], and the remaining pound concepts ([lb_ap], [lb_tr]) are ~18% lighter. No change to the expression.

versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Scope: the patient's current body weight, measured or with no method stated. Added SNOMED 37160438 Post-amputation measured body weight and LOINC Body weight Measured (3013762) with its contexts: pre/post dialysis (3019336, 3009617), pre/postoperative (3005422, 3015644), ante/post partum (3013853, 3010147), when specimen taken (40761330), with/without clothes (3010220, 3011054). Body weight with/without shoes (4310154, 4175354) no longer excluded: measured current weights, same definition and dimension (reverses the v1.1.0 exclusion). Dry body weight (40484200) now excluded: a target weight, not a current measured one. Recommended unit kg for all; conversions from pounds and grams.
